title: A PORT_PROTOCOL frame with neither protocolId nor edge
notes: source: WV-PORT-API-STALL-SUSPENDED-01, mutation: `"type":"PORT_API"` rewritten to `"type":"PORT_PROTOCOL"`; no `protocolId` or `edge` key is added — both are absent from the seed already, as an optional field the codec omits by default. pinned-because-current ([WIR1-C16], epic table item a): observed java.lang.IllegalStateException "PORT_PROTOCOL frame missing protocolId", thrown by WireCodec.invocation's checkNotNull AFTER the envelope's JSON parse succeeds — the spec requires the rejection but not this order; a decode that rejected earlier would still satisfy [WIR1-I10]. Dead-letter accounting on the receiving side is covered by wire/src/test/kotlin/civictech/wire/WsIngressDecodeFailureTest.kt, not retested here.
